_coverage.title: Patient rejects all proposed times and changes constraints

name: changes_visit_type_and_date_range_after_rejecting_times
input: No, evenings are bad. Actually, I can come in person instead. Any in-person follow up openings next week, like March 18–21, during the day?

conversation.content: Hi, this is Robin from Bramblewood Clinic. Are you Jordan Lee, and what’s your date of birth?
Thanks, Jordan. Is this for a new patient visit, a follow-up, or a telehealth follow-up?
Telehealth follow-up sometime this week is best.
Okay, I’ll look for a telehealth follow-up this week and send you a couple of options.
I can do a telehealth follow-up Thu at 4:00 pm or Fri at 5:20 pm. Do either of those work?
No, evenings are bad. Actually, I can come in person instead. Any in-person follow up openings next week, like March 18–21, during the day?

grading_criteria: The agent must see that the patient rejected the offered telehealth times and changed both the visit type (from telehealth_follow_up to in-person follow_up) and the date range (to next week, around March 18–21, during the day). It must call find_open_slots again with visitType=follow_up, location consistent with the patient’s flexibility ("any" is acceptable here), and fromDate/toDate covering 2026-03-18 to 2026-03-21. It must not reuse the earlier telehealth search results. In the reply, it should offer two or three in-person follow-up times returned by the new search, clearly stating day, time, and location, and ask which works. It should not book yet or imply a time is held. Tone must follow texting rules and avoid mentioning tools.

checks.reran_search_with_new_visit_type: Did the agent call find_open_slots again with visitType set to "follow_up" instead of reusing "telehealth_follow_up"?
checks.updated_date_range_for_next_week: Did the agent set fromDate/toDate to cover March 18–21, as requested, rather than the previous "this week" range?
checks.did_not_reuse_telehealth_slots: Did the agent avoid offering the old telehealth slots again and instead rely on the new find_open_slots results?
checks.no_booking_before_choice: Did the agent refrain from calling book_appointment until the patient chooses a specific offered time?
